knownAdditionalStorage.meaning: Raw repository file sizes; excludes environments and runtime artifacts

policy: Preserve 30 GiB host free space; preflight each artifact and Docker data partition separately; never delete unrelated resources.
existingDockerResources: 3 active images, 3 active containers, 2 active volumes; preserve all
limitations: Repository sizes exclude extraction, indexes, weights, environments, build cache and logs. Do not sum host and Docker free space. Check actual image/build needs per batch. This command never deletes or resizes resources.
